name: Medicaid open data (data.medicaid.gov)
summary: CMS Medicaid datasets, including State Drug Utilization Data (SDUD) and NADAC drug acquisition costs: find a dataset, then filter, sort and page its rows.
notes: Keyless and read-only here; the write and harvest endpoints of the same API need site credentials and are left out.

Two-step flow: find a dataset's identifier with datasets.search (e.g. fulltext 'NADAC 2026' or 'State Drug Utilization Data 2024'; SDUD and NADAC are one dataset per year), then query rows with rows.query using that identifier and distribution index 0.
rows.query pages with limit and offset and reports the total match count in 'count'; set schema=false to drop the column schema from each response.
Column names are machine names (e.g. ndc, ndc_description, nadac_per_unit, effective_date for NADAC); read one row first to learn them.

endpoints.name: Search the dataset catalog
endpoints.summary: Datasets whose metadata match a full-text search, with identifiers, titles and descriptions.

sort.description: Sort property: title, modified, description, keyword, publisher__name, theme or search_api_relevance.

facets.description: Comma-separated facets to return; 0 for none; omit for all.

endpoints.name: Get a dataset's metadata
endpoints.summary: One dataset's title, description, update dates and distributions.

show_reference_ids.description: Include the distribution identifiers the datastore endpoints use.

endpoints.name: Query a dataset's rows
endpoints.summary: Rows of one dataset filtered by conditions, sorted and paged, as JSON.

index.description: Position of the distribution in the dataset's distribution list; 0 for the first.

conditions.description: Filters ANDed together, each {property, value, operator}; operator is one of =, <>, <, <=, >, >=, like, between, in, not in, contains, starts with, match (default =).

properties.description: Columns to return; all when omitted.

sorts.description: Sort directives, each {property, order} with order asc or desc.

limit.description: Most rows to return; at least 1.

count.description: Return the total match count; default true.

results.description: Return the rows; false with count true gives only the count.

schema.description: Return the column schema; default true.

keys.description: Rows as keyed objects (default true) or plain arrays.

notes: A read over POST: the query travels as the JSON body.

endpoints.name: Query rows with SQL-like syntax
endpoints.summary: Rows from a datastore table selected with bracketed SELECT, WHERE and LIMIT/OFFSET clauses.

query.description: Each clause in brackets, no spaces between selected columns, ending with a semicolon: [SELECT a,b FROM DATASTORE_UUID][WHERE c = "CCC"][LIMIT 500 OFFSET 0];

show_db_columns.description: Return machine column names (no spaces) instead of human headers.

notes: FROM takes the distribution's datastore identifier (from datasets.get with show-reference-ids), not the dataset identifier.
At most 500 rows per query; page with LIMIT/OFFSET.
